name: @di-framework/cli-plugin-wasmcloud
description: di-framework CLI extension that builds, serves, and deploys DI Framework apps as wasmCloud WebAssembly components.
author: @di-framework Contributors

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.dist.json && bun build assets/http-adapter.ts --outfile dist/assets/http-adapter.js --packages bundle --external 'wasi:*' --external 'wasmcloud:*' --external 'virtual:di-framework-application' --external 'virtual:di-framework-wasmcloud-guests' && cp -R assets/wit dist/assets/wit && cp -R assets/platform dist/assets/platform
